summary: The repaired Phase 3 artifact passes its full mechanical gate (28 tests, typecheck, lint, and build) and now has a typed canonical ProgramStore, dynamic Program/effect status displays, editable split/crossfade state, list/preset handlers, and a single EffectsGraph boundary with six buses, ordered units, limiter, click-safe native wet/dry gains, and deterministic offline DSP. It is still a partial Programs/effects recreation: rendered workflows remain shallow (no real Store destination/name flow or Live recall), morph sources and zone assignment are not fully input-wired, native units are generic filters/delays rather than documented effect models, per-layer/global/group/To Rotary routing is shared or incomplete, and Piano adds a parallel wet path that duplicates the graph master path. Desktop geometry is retained, but the narrow capture remains a horizontally clipped 820px canvas and the evidence image is stale (caption says Piano Phase 02).

evidence: evidence/stage3-desktop.png at 1440x900 retains the Stage 4 73 continuous red chassis, 3.095:1 silhouette, 54/46 deck/keybed allocation, six section order, and 43 white + 30 black keys from the selected stage-4-73 variant.

The render remains materially simpler than the primary photograph (schematic controls, sparse legends, and stale caption text reading Piano Phase 02); stage3-narrow.png keeps an 820px minimum canvas and is clipped in a 390px viewport.
main.tsx Panel reads canonical ProgramStore state for Program name/category/list/dirty, effect wet/dry status, and the bottom rail reports split points, active scene, and morph count.

The hardware remains generic SmallButton/Knob/Fader representations: no credible morph LED/fader indicators, zone LEDs, contextual four-view Program display, detailed effect parameter controls, or manual-accurate focus/routing states are rendered.

ProgramStore lines 34-69 implement serializable state, dirty tracking, Store/Store As, cancel, undo, program browsing, presets, and eight live-slot storage; the UI exposes Store, Store As, Undo, Cancel, Page, list-mode, and preset buttons.

Store As auto-generates names, preset loading is a single synthetic preset, and Live 1-8 only call setLive (there is no rendered Live Mode/recall path or complete naming/category/destination confirmation flow from manual pages 40-44).

ProgramStore supports all eleven C2-C7 split positions, 0/6/12 crossfade values, four-zone arrays, Scene I/II, and Wheel/Aftertouch/Control Pedal assignments; main.tsx forwards edited split/crossfade values into PianoEngine routing.

No rendered zone-membership editor exists, morph assignment is fixed to layer.pianoA, Control Pedal has no input path, and morph indicators/interpolation destinations beyond the narrow store API are absent.
Rendered Program controls now expose Page browsing, Numeric/Alphabetic/Category list-mode buttons, preset loading, and dynamic name/category/list/dirty text; ProgramStore clamps four display modes.

The OLED does not actually render four contextual Program View layouts or parameter hints, Program Display is not an interactive control, Store As has no character/category editor, and copy/paste, organize, and monitor editing are not rendered (manual pp. 40-44).

EffectsGraph constructs one context boundary, six named layer buses, serial Mod1 → Mod2 → Delay → Amp/EQ → Compressor → Reverb → Rotary chains, master bus, limiter, and destination; native parallel dry/wet gains use short setTargetAtTime automation.

PianoEngine also connects each voice through a separate wetDelay/reverbGain path directly back into the graph master bus, duplicating/bypassing portions of the ordered chain; all layer buses share one effect state rather than independent per-layer chain settings.

EffectsGraph.process contains deterministic transformations for Mod 1, Mod 2, Delay, Amp/EQ, Compressor, Reverb, and Rotary, and programs-effects.test.ts asserts each changes samples and all-effects bypass restores the dry buffer.

The browser graph uses generic BiquadFilterNode/DelayNode placeholders for most units: documented modes, Delay feedback filters/effects, rotary modulation, amp models, and reverb types are not implemented, so coverage is class-level rather than Nord-like.

main.tsx updates both ProgramStore and EffectsGraph for unit on/amount/dry-wet, global, group, all-bypass, and coarse focus controls; EffectsGraph applies native bypass/wet-dry automation and exposes To Rotary state.

Focus A/B mapping is incorrect for Focus B, global/group are shared booleans across every bus, To Rotary enables the single rotary unit for all layers, and no per-layer targeting or Delay feedback-loop routing is demonstrated against the live graph (manual pp. 48-52).

ProgramStore is the canonical serialized owner for layers, Piano/effect state, routing, zones, morphs, scenes, history, and dirty metadata; tests cover round-trip, cancel, undo, scenes, splits, morphs, and Store/Live metadata.

The React local control map duplicates canonical state, Program load/recall does not synchronize PianoEngine controls or native graph settings, and scene/layer edits can leave scene definitions and engine routing out of sync.
Split button handlers update PianoEngine low/mid/high boundaries and crossfade width; effect controls update canonical effect state and graph state; Piano level/type/reverb controls reach the engine.

Layer zone membership is never applied from ProgramStore, PianoEngine chooses piano-A except when B is the only enabled layer, and morph input paths/targets do not drive the full audible routing contract.

Independent pnpm test passes 5 files/28 tests; pnpm typecheck, pnpm lint, and pnpm build all pass, matching the stage3 verification gates. Inherited Phase 1/2 tests and feature-matrix entries remain present.
The evidence capture is not a fresh exercised Phase 3 state (caption still says Piano Phase 02), and no real browser console/audio-output stress pass is included.

ProgramStore, EffectsGraph, and PianoEngine are separate typed modules with stable layer/effect IDs, serializable state, deterministic offline rendering, injectable AudioContext boundaries, and accurate no-recorded-sample provenance.

The native graph remains a coarse generic-node approximation, ProgramStore-to-engine synchronization is incomplete, all layers share effect settings, and Piano's parallel wet path undermines the claimed single ordered signal architecture.

tests/feature-matrix.json maps all required Phase 3 IDs; 28 tests cover serialization, store/undo, list modes, split/morph state, graph topology, offline representative DSP, fake-context automation, and inherited Piano behavior.

Most audio assertions use EffectsGraph.process(Float32Array) rather than a rendered native graph; UI tests do not prove Live recall, native focus/group/global/To Rotary routing, zone assignment, or browser audible effects.
EffectsGraph.dispose disconnects buses/nodes, PianoEngine limits voices and cleans oscillators, and all four pnpm gates complete without errors; desktop evidence shows stable loading.

No fresh browser console/audible stress capture is provided, native units are intentionally generic, and duplicated wet/master routing plus incomplete per-layer targeting leave clipping and rapid layered-effect behavior unverified.

issues: Complete rendered Program workflows: real program load/recall, Live Mode recall, Store/Store As destination and naming/category confirmation, and four contextual Program View/list displays.

Make morph sources (Wheel, Aftertouch, Control Pedal) and all documented destinations observable input paths with indicators; add a zone-membership editor and apply layer zones/crossfade to every audible layer.

Replace generic native Biquad/Delay placeholders with connected representative Mod, Delay feedback/filter, Amp/EQ, Compressor, Reverb, and Rotary processing, including per-layer focus/group/global/To Rotary targeting and click-safe bypass.
Remove PianoEngine's parallel wetDelay/reverb path so every voice traverses exactly one ordered EffectsGraph/master path; synchronize Program load/scene/layer state into PianoEngine and graph state.

Refresh Phase 3 desktop/narrow evidence after exercising Program/effect flows, correct the stale Piano Phase 02 caption, and address the 390px horizontal clipping or document it as an explicit limitation.
